# Mail keyboard native acceptance

CI-MAIL-KEYBOARD-ACCEPTANCE-001 (#2308), permanent NEVER MERGE. This is a fresh
candidate; historical local tests were not recovered and are not current evidence.
Dependencies: #2307 authentic runtime, #2309 trace policy, #2521 state oracle,
unchanged lifecycle helper 7dc5939 and the product #2310. No orphan publication.

Each baseline/fixed x 1280/1600 job owns fresh PG17/Redis7, natural demo account
and city, then four genuine gm send-mail fixtures. Native Tab/Enter/Space/pointer
exercise message B, separate D checkbox, unread removals A/D/C and fallback focus.
The baseline positively observes inaccessible B and uses pointer reads afterward;
it never qualifies for fixed acceptance. All steps retain SQL and wire invariants.
Long-title overflow, viewport clipping, center occlusion and focus outlines are
asserted from actual DOM geometry; eight screenshots per job require independent
visual review. Settled focus is not proof of an in-flight async interval.

Pure controls run with node --test .github/scripts/live_mail_keyboard.test.mjs.
Product and dependency pins identify reviewed immutable trees; source mapping
and final pinned workflow review remain separate pre-execution gates.
No native execution, successful artifact, or acceptance is claimed by these files.
All components, pristine product tests/build, exact-head CI, real native artifacts,
clean owned shutdown and independent review remain mandatory before product release.
